name: wait_for_event_resource_load

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_WaitForEventResourceLoad retains the top load-slot value while the corresponding asynchronous-load bit is set, then decrements Script stackTop by one when the bit clears

notes: Load slot 1 polls D_003854E0.unk_3070 bit 33 and slot 2 polls bit 34. Command 92 sets the matching bit before queueing a resource load and its two completion callbacks clear those bits after registering every loaded resource entry. The JP corpus contains 69 calls: 67 poll slot 1 and two poll slot 2.
